note: NGAP messages on N2 between OAI's AMF and CN-TG's gNB processes in the testbed captures named in source, extracted with tshark (SCTP PPID 60, the NGAP dissector off). Sources 0-3: experiment 06, OAI's AMF v7 images and CN-TG's perf-max-load G10 and G14 images, registrations only (no PDU session, no UE context release); per capture, spread over the AMF UE NGAP IDs: downlink, 28 DownlinkNASTransports per NAS message (Authentication Request, Security Mode Command), 28 InitialContextSetupRequests and an NGSetupResponse; uplink, 7 InitialUEMessages, UplinkNASTransports per NAS message (Authentication Response, protected ones) and InitialContextSetupResponses, and an NGSetupRequest. Sources 4-8: experiment 06's R3 runs (registration and PDU session, 300 UEs each; OAI's AMF perf-v0 and SMF perf-v1 images, CN-TG's perf-max-load image before G12, pycrate's path); per capture, spread over the AMF UE NGAP IDs: downlink, 28 PDUSessionResourceSetupRequests; uplink, 7 PDUSessionResourceSetupResponses. frame: the message's frame in its capture; dir: dl (AMF to gNB) or ul.
